## 問題
2025 年 11 月整體取消率是多少？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 14.59
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層「已取消訂單」定義為 orders.status = 9，期間以訂單成立時間 order_ts 篩選 2025-11-01 至 2025-11-30，分母為該期間不重複訂單數（含所有狀態）。結果為 697 / 4777 × 100 = 14.59。order_ts 的時區假設為台北時間，未另行驗證。
SQL 1: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(order_ts) AS min_ts, MAX(order_ts) AS max_ts FROM orders WHERE order_ts LIKE '2025-11%' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
  結果: {'columns': ['status', 'n', 'min_ts', 'max_ts'], 'rows': [[0, 225, '2025-11-01 08:55:33', '2025-11-30 18:53:54'], [1, 283, '2025-11-01 02:20:21', '2025-11-30 23:46:14'], [2, 434, '2025-11-01 03:17:57', '2025-11-30 23:10:55'], [3, 3138, '2025-11-01 00:02:35', '2025-11-30 23:38:50'], [9, 697, '2025-11
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN order_id END) AS cancelled_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS cancel_rate_pct FROM orders WHERE order_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
  結果: {'columns': ['total_orders', 'cancelled_orders', 'cancel_rate_pct'], 'rows': [[4777, 697, 14.59]], 'truncated': False}

## 回答 B
最終答案: 14.58
採用的定義與依據: 取消率 = 訂單狀態為 9（已取消）的訂單數 ÷ 全部訂單數，期間依 orders.order_ts 換算台北時間（UTC+8）後落在 2025-11-01 至 2025-11-30 的訂單。結果為 695 / 4768 × 100 = 14.58。
SQL 1: ["SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status", "SELECT order_id, order_ts, status, channel FROM orders ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 10"]

SQL 2: ["SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancel_rate_pct FROM orders WHERE datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-12-01 00:00:00'"]
